property_summary: For every call to Command by Owner forwarding VALUE to an external address with arbitrary calldata, the reference contract P never reverts (i.e., Command always returns/does not revert) because it uses an unchecked low-level call that does not propagate callee reverts; the mutant M uses delegatecall and requires success, so there exist calldata/target that cause Command to revert — the test asserts that Command never reverts on P but can revert on M for some fuzzed target/value/callee behavior.
change_summary: Replace call to delegatecall so the target executes in this contract's context, potentially changing storage and affecting subsequent Command-observable state.
